lesson: The forecast distributed probability among specific settlements and omitted the umbrella geography used at resolution. Even when a question appears to request a specific destination, candidate generation should include the broader administrative or regional label if official funding documents may report only that level of detail.

Iceland was correctly assigned 97 percent once Argentina's final warm-up schedule was established. Confirmed fixture identity can support near-certainty while preserving a small allowance for cancellation or schedule changes.

The slate leaned on recent high-profile Artemis and Orion astronauts and omitted veteran commander Randy Bresnik. NASA crew-role forecasts need a wider pool that includes experienced mission commanders and astronaut-office leadership, not only astronauts associated with the immediately preceding Artemis mission.
